args.title: Bellwether: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Bellwether's newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026" reports that autonomous carts lifted warehouse pick rates by 18%.
- Integration of the automation took twice as long as originally planned.
- The companion piece (insights.bellwether.example) notes the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse and https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion (accessed via newsletter link with work email registration).
